in_marathi.name: Vishnudev
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God in the form of Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishnudev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vishnudev is derived from the Sanskrit words Vishnu, meaning god, and Dev, meaning god or divine. Vishnudev is a name for the Hindu deity Vishnu, who is the preserver in the Hindu trinity. He is the protector and sustainer of the universe, and the embodiment of love, compassion, and purity.
